title: What changes when 300 dbt users at Virgin Media O2 move to dbt v2 and dbt State
description:
How Virgin Media O2 cut dbt compute costs about 30% and sped up 5,500+ models with dbt v2 and dbt State. From dbt Summit 2026.

Explore dbt Summit 2026 and watch more sessions: https://www.getdbt.com/dbt-summit

Two analytics engineers from Virgin Media O2, the UK's largest converged telecoms network serving 42 million customers on a single-tenant dbt platform instance on BigQuery, show what happens when a dbt project outgrows the tools built to run it. dbt State let dbt skip rebuilding what had not changed: on a 1,424-model job, only 1,392 models needed to rerun. The migration delivered about 30% lower compute costs, 35% faster runs, and 25% less CI/CD dependency.

In this session you'll learn:
• How dbt State skips unchanged models to cut runtime and BigQuery slot consumption
• What an enterprise-scale dbt v2 migration looks like in real numbers
• Why lost developer hours were the biggest cost nobody tracked

Speakers: Analytics engineering team, Virgin Media O2

Read more: With dbt State, stop rebuilding what didn't change. https://www.getdbt.com/blog/dbt-state-stop-rebuilding
